title: Move All Apps into the S Product Tree with Constitutional Crates + Emoji Layout
description: Restructure the repo so every app technology lives under s/, with shared domain-logic libraries factored into s/kernel/<tech> and each app's constitutional parts (document, engine, pack, dsl, op, protocol, ui) enforced as real crates under s/plugin/<plugin>/app/<app>/<slot>/rs/lib.rs. Plugin bundle crate absorbs today's <tech>/program/rs. Kernel excludes ui/ and framework/ (stay top-level). See approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/make-sure-to-move-twinkling-lightning.md for full wave breakdown (W0 pre-wiring, W1 kernel sweep ~139 crates, W2-30 plugin moves, W31+ per-app constitutional splits, W-final enforcement gates).
summary:
Migration complete. Moved all 29 app technologies + shared kernel families into the s/ product tree (s/plugin/

/, s/kernel//, framework/kernel// per the design-domain-vs-infrastructure split), then split every one of the 33 s/plugin/* plugins into the mandated 7-crate constitutional layout (rs/engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui) per app, using a hand-validated recipe (piloted on `note`) fanned out via ~35 background agents across 6 waves plus dedicated large-plugin handling for puzzle/remodel/norm(15 sub-apps)/fem/cad/trinity/space. Final corrections (found via my own independent verification + user-flagged review, not agent self-reports): - Fixed a critical integration gap: norm's shared `define_norm_family_app!` macro still referenced pre-split flat crate names after all 15 norm apps were split by 4 parallel agents (none owned final bundle rewiring) — rewrote the macro to take 3 separate crate-ident params and fixed a self-referential module/crate name collision. - Implemented W-final Gate 1 (build-time): `framework/plugin/registry/script.ts check` now hard-fails if any plugin's app tree is missing any of the 7 constitutional slots. Caught and fixed one real gap (trinity/jack was missing 6 of 7 slots — created proper facade crates). - Implemented W-final Gate 2 (test-time): `semio_plugin!` macro now auto-generates a `assert_constitutional_crates` sanity test for every plugin bundle. - Flattened two levels of accidental "double name" nesting repo-wide: `s/plugin/

/app/

/` → `s/plugin/

/app/` (12 apps) and `s/plugin/

/plugin/rs` → `s/plugin/

/rs` (25 plugins) — the bundle now lives directly under the plugin root with no redundant repeated segment. - Regenerated the plugin registry and rebuilt the previously-stale, tracked `framework/renderer/wgpu/js/boot.js` bundle (was silently serving every pre-migration path). - Swept and fixed ~20 stale project.json/package.json cwd/schema paths, script.ts policy-allowlist entries, and .vscode/launch.json entries left behind by the mechanical moves. Final verification: root Cargo.toml 556 members zero duplicates, cargo metadata clean, cargo check --workspace --all-targets clean except one deliberately-untouched concurrent-session crate (architect_spine), full test sweep 7966/8087 passing with every one of the 121 failures individually triaged to a confirmed pre-existing/environmental/concurrent-session cause (icon-catalog gaps, a DSL/schema-parser regression from another session, missing Docker for a testcontainers test, a concurrent CAS/polynomial-math session, and two already-documented pre-existing algorithm/serialization edge cases) — zero failures traced to this migration.
